        Lz = box[2][1] - box[2][0]

    # D = slope / 6
    D = slope / 6.0

        delta = curr_pos - prev_pos

        delta[:, 0] -= Lx * np.round(delta[:, 0] / Lx)
        delta[:, 1] -= Ly * np.round(delta[:, 1] / Ly)
        delta[:, 2] -= Lz * np.round(delta[:, 2] / Lz)
        
        unwrapped.append(prev_pos + delta)

    """
    n_frames = len(positions_list)

    # Use the first frame as reference
